User story: As a customer, I want to log in with email + password, so that I can access my account
Acceptance criteria: GIVEN a registered user WHEN they submit valid credentials THEN they are redirected to /dashboard within 500ms; GIVEN invalid credentials WHEN submitted THEN show inline error and remain on /login

User story: As a customer, I want to reset my password via email, so that I can recover my account
Acceptance criteria: GIVEN a forgotten password WHEN I request reset THEN I receive an email with a link valid for 1h; the link sets a new password and logs me in
